mapper.select: SELECT TRIM(CAT_CD) AS CAT_CD, SEQ_NO, FILE_NO, TRIM(ATTACHED_FILE_NAME) AS ATTACHED_FILE_NAME, ATTACHED_FILE_SIZE FROM T_ATTACHED_FILE WHERE TRIM(CAT_CD) = TRIM(#{catCd}) AND SEQ_NO = #{seqNo} ORDER BY FILE_NO
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_ATTACHED_FILE (CAT_CD, SEQ_NO, FILE_NO, ATTACHED_FILE_NAME, ATTACHED_FILE_SIZE) VALUES (TRIM(#{catCd}), #{seqNo}, #{fileNo}, TRIM(#{attachedFileName}), #{attachedFileSize})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM T_ATTACHED_FILE WHERE TRIM(CAT_CD) = TRIM(#{catCd}) AND SEQ_NO = #{seqNo} AND FILE_NO = #{fileNo}
DELETE FROM T_ATTACHED_FILE WHERE TRIM(CAT_CD) = TRIM(#{catCd}) AND SEQ_NO = #{seqNo}
